releases.displayName: Ninja Kidz Time Masters – Quick Draw ShowDown Update is here

notes.title: THE QUICKDRAW SHOWDOWN UPDATE IS NOW LIVE

items.text: Starting today, you can jump into the brand new content for Ninja Kidz Time Masters. This DLC arrives packed with fresh action and new challenges designed to bring a fun, energetic twist to your adventures in the game.

The first thing you’ll notice is Kayson, the new playable character from the Ninja Fam. With his unique style and tons of energy, he joins the crew so you can try out new ways to play and give your missions a totally fresh vibe.

Your journey continues in a completely new stage, the Wild West, a setting inspired by the classic Old West where themed enemies, different challenges, and a whole new mood are waiting for you. Just like in previous levels, you’ll come across unique moments and encounters that make this new area a blast to explore.

And of course, there’s a brand new final challenge. The Animator steps in as the new boss of the DLC, a villain capable of drawing enemies and bringing them to life right in the middle of the fight. Get ready to dodge his wild creations, adapt to his attacks, and bring all your skills to the table to take him down.
All of this new content is available starting today. We can’t wait for you to dive in, discover everything that’s waiting for you, and have an amazing time with the Quickdraw Showdown Update.
See you in the Wild West!
